input.query: WITH daily AS (SELECT decision_date, SUM(n_decisions) n, SUM(n_approved) approved, SUM(n_approved)*1.0/SUM(n_decisions) rate FROM agg_kyc_daily WHERE decision_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-09-01' AND DATE '2025-12-15' GROUP BY 1), w AS (SELECT CASE WHEN decision_date < DATE '2025-11-01' THEN 'baseline' ELSE 'recent' END period, SUM(n) n, SUM(approved) approved, SUM(approved)*1.0/SUM(n) rate FROM daily GROUP BY 1) SELECT * FROM w ORDER BY period
